action.label: The specific verb to be done

app_name.label: Application name as you call it

c_consumption_price_variance.label: C3 - metered spend against plan

cost_per_active_user.label: Cost per person actually using it

data_source.label: Which sources this row came from

dependency_count.label: Number of integration edges touching it

governance_visibility.source: REQ 63 from the REQ 61 presence flags plus owner and contract resolution

gross_saving_annual.label: Saving before netting

has_downstream_dependents.label: Something breaks if this is switched off

in_notice_window_now.label: Notice deadline is within 180 days

information_classification.label: Most sensitive class of data held

infotech_template_disposition.label: What the licensed reference table returns

is_ai_tool.source: REQ 11 classifier over name, vendor and description

is_orphaned.label: No accountable owner could be established

is_shadow_it.label: Paid for or in use but not governed
is_shadow_it.source: REQ 8: AP spend or SSO activity with no CMDB record

licence_utilisation_rate.label: Share of bought seats actually used

lifecycle_stage.label: Where the app is in its own life

missing_fields.label: Which model-consumed fields are empty
missing_fields.source: The empty subset of those 44 fields; 'unknown' counts as empty

net_saving_annual.label: Saving after netting

notice_deadline_date.label: The real deadline to serve notice

ov_enhance_services.label: V4 - does clinical work stop without it? (v1 name for ov_patient_care_criticality)

ov_increase_value.label: V1 - does it carry money in or out?

ov_patient_care_criticality.label: V4 - does clinical work stop without it?

ov_reach_consumers.label: V2 - breadth of use
ov_reach_consumers.source: Rubric band over active_users vs licences_purchased (REQ 21)

ov_reduce_costs_efficiency.label: V3 - process centrality
ov_reduce_costs_efficiency.source: Rubric band over the process_centrality answer (REQ 21)

overlap_cluster_id.label: Overlap cluster it belongs to
overlap_cluster_id.source: REQ 25 clustering on capability, feature coverage, user overlap and cost

owner_stated_strategic_importance.label: What the owner says it is worth strategically

primary_capability.fallback: REQ 19 infers from description. LOSS: the C1 cost-per-user peer group and all redundancy clustering are built on this field.

priority.label: How urgent

process_centrality.label: How central to the process it serves

r_business_compliance_risk.label: R2 - PHI exposure, residency, SOC 2 / HITRUST

r_clinical_safety_risk.label: R3 - patient-safety consequence of an outage

r_end_user_perceived_quality.label: R4 - what users think of it

r_technical_risk.label: R1 - single points of failure, DR, hardening

rationale.label: The written reason

renewal_notice_days.label: Days notice required before term end

replacement_app_id.label: The named successor

replacement_cost_already_in_baseline.label: Successor is already a paid line here

residual_archival_cost.fallback: modelled from data_types_held and the REQ 57 footprint (REQ 53 marks full archival costing a stretch). LOSS: net saving overstated on every retire.

retention_obligation_flag.label: Data must be kept after switch-off

reward_split_basis.label: Why a Reward row was called retain or invest
reward_split_basis.source: split_reward(): which test of the retain/invest split fired. Blank on every non-Reward pattern

risk_posture_score.label: Risk posture (R)
risk_posture_score.source: Weighted mean of the R criteria (R4 disabled)

saving_type.label: Recurring, one-time or none

tco_five_category_subtotal.label: The five reference cost categories
